summary: Cognizant filed an 8-K reporting the October 5, 2026 closing of a new $2.4 billion senior unsecured credit package consisting of a $550 million term loan and a $1.85 billion revolver, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. Term proceeds repaid the prior term loan, and roughly $1.0 billion was drawn on the revolver to repay the old revolver. Both facilities mature October 3, 2031, with quarterly $6.875 million term amortization after year one and pricing initially Term Benchmark plus 0.875% or ABR plus 0%. No equity event, so this is a routine refinancing rather than a special situation.
